title: Factorization Identities and Plane-Ideal Membership for the Fermat Quartic Fourfold, Formalized in Lean 4
description: Lean 4 + Mathlib (v4.22.0) formalization, over any commutative ring, of the identities showing the Fermat quartic z0^4+...+z5^4 lies in the ideal (z0-zeta z1, z2-zeta z3, z4-zeta z5) when zeta^4=-1: division with remainder (1+zeta^4)w^4, four-factor identity, explicit decompositions, ideal membership (fermat_mem_Z1), the sextic analogue, and the count 15*4^3=960. Spanning of Hodge classes is not formalized. 17 theorems, no sorry, no native_decide, standard axioms only. The attached paper states exactly these results.
